candidate_expansion.expansion_order_rule: first the 480 smallest unpriced directions by SHA256(domain || raw_i8(direction)), breaking hash ties by raw_i8; then every deterministic dependent-record Hopcroft-Karp match absent from that prefix, in increasing retained-record index; then hash-ranked directions absent from the prefix until 1024 columns; finally the remaining hash-ranked unpriced directions

claim_boundary: Exact finite diagnostics of the frozen G-0179 matrix and its two modular RREFs. Equal rank at two primes is strong evidence but does not prove the rank over Q is 5291. The post-outcome expansion order is target-blind but rank-outcome-aware; it is not a preregistered rank result or theorem.
